notes.title: v1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you to all players for your support and feedback on the game! Based on your suggestions, we have made the following updates and optimizations to the game this week:[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b] [list] [*] [b]Tooltip Display Toggle Feature:[/b] Players can now choose whether to display tooltip information in the settings, providing a more personalized and focused gaming experience. [/list] [b]Content Updates:[/b] [list] [*] Added more background music in various modes to enhance game immersion. [/list] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] [list] [*] Fixed display formatting issues caused by localization in multiple scenes. [*] Fixed an issue that occurred under specific conditions when rotating tiles or areas. [/list] [b]Optimizations and Adjustments:[/b] [list] [*] [b]Display Settings Optimization:[/b] Improved the logic for the default monitor selection, resolving potential issues on multi-monitor systems. [*] [b]Hints Optimization for Puzzle Mode and Tutorials:[/b] Task hints in puzzle mode and tutorials are now more clear and intuitive, helping players get started faster. [*] [b]Achievement and Building Unlock Layout Optimization:[/b] Adjusted the layout logic for achievements and unlocked buildings, making the interface more organized and visually appealing. [/list] We realize there is still much room for improvement in the game, and we sincerely look forward to receiving your valuable feedback and suggestions via Steam or our Discord channel. Thank you again for your support of our game!

[b]Have fun gaming![/b]
SweetTaco
25.3.28

notes.title: Theurgy Architect: Official Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Players,[/h3]
After relentless effort, we are thrilled to announce that our game is now officially launched! We warmly welcome everyone to join and experience the game. We hope it brings you an enjoyable time.

We also want to express our heartfelt gratitude to every single player who participated in the testing phase. Your support and feedback have allowed us to continuously improve and deliver this final version.

In addition, we sincerely invite you to join our Discord channel or reach out through other platforms to provide suggestions, report bugs, or share your ideas. We greatly value every player's voice and look forward to your input to help make the game even better.

[h3]Have fun and enjoy the game! Thank you once again for your companionship and support![/h3]
SweetTaco
25.3.23

notes.title: Demo v1.3 Update
notes.notes:
[h2] Thank You for Participating in Our Game Beta Experience! [/h2]
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by some bugs and unreasonable processes in the beta version.
At the same time, we deeply appreciate your bug reports and optimization suggestions for the beta version.
These contributions have helped us improve the game’s quality, making it even better.
Now, we are officially releasing a brand-new update version. Here are the specific optimizations:
[h3] New Features [/h3]
[list]
[*] Region Rotation Functionality: You can now use the rotation feature when acquiring and editing regions, drastically improving operational flexibility.
[*] Resource UI Transparency Adjustment: Added a transparency adjustment option, making the UI more adaptable to players' visual preferences.
[*] Preview Optimization in Edit Mode: Added real-time previews for unreasonable operations to help players make more intuitive adjustments.
[*] Tutorials and Tips: A large number of beginner tutorials and operation tips have been added, making the onboarding experience more user-friendly.
[*] Discord Quick Access Button: A new shortcut button has been added to the main interface, allowing players to conveniently join the Discord community for discussions and feedback.
[/list]
[h3] Bug Fixes [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Save Errors: Resolved an issue in older versions that could cause save files to fail to load properly.
[*] Fixed Save Prompt Display Bug: Addressed a bug where save prompt information was displayed incompletely, enhancing the save experience.
[/list]
[h3] Functional Optimizations [/h3]
[list]
[*] Building Construction and Spell Timer: Improved display method to prevent UI overlap, offering clearer and more intuitive information display.
[*] Merge Button Prompt: Optimized interaction prompts, making the user experience smoother and more natural.
[*] Beta Difficulty Curve Adjustment: Improved the process and difficulty curve, creating a more balanced and comfortable experience.
[/list]
We understand that there are still some imperfections in the current version, so we look forward to receiving more of your feedback and suggestions for improvement!
You can contact us through the following channels:
[list]
[*] Join our Discord Channel to participate in discussions and exchanges.
[*] Or provide feedback directly in the Beta Event Announcement.
[/list]
Finally, thank you again for your participation in this test! We look forward to working with you to make this game even better.

Enjoy the game!
SweetTaco
2025.2.25

notes.title: Demo v1.2 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for trying out our Demo version. 

We deeply apologize for the numerous bugs and process-related issues you may have encountered in the current Demo. At the same time, we look forward to working with you to witness the growth of this game together!

Our Discord channel is now live https://discord.gg/nj4vmvXc, and we warmly welcome any suggestions or bug reports you may have. Your feedback will be invaluable in making our game better!

Additionally, we will use the Discord channel to share information about known issues and bugs, along with the content planned for future updates. We look forward to your participation and interaction!

[h2]v1.2 Update Details[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added spell visual adjustment settings
[*] Added a tutorial skip option
[*] Added clearer explanations for tutorial quests and spell usage
[*] Added more background music
[*] Added descriptions for resource tier effects

[*] Fixed an issue where interrupting a spell caused a program error
[*] Fixed era progress bar display issues
[*] Fixed tooltip blocking spellcasting actions
[*] Fixed logic errors in music looping
[*] Fixed issues where hidden icons failed to reappear after reloading

[*] Optimized spellcasting effects
[*] Adjusted Demo difficulty balance
[*] Improved sound trigger mechanics and added failure sound effects
[/list]

[h2]About existing save files: [/h2]
Based on our tests, the new version is compatible with saves from previous versions. However, if you encounter any issues while loading, please clear your save data through the main menu. To make up for the time lost, we have added the tutorial skip feature. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We hope you enjoy the game!
SweetTaco
2025.2.24
